04 / FULL-STACK PRODUCT CASE STUDY

CareerConnect.

A two-sided hiring platform with job-seeker and employer workflows spanning a React frontend and Express/MongoDB backend.

React Vite Tailwind Node.js Express MongoDB JWT Multer
PRODUCT SURFACE

Different users,
different workflows.

CareerConnect gives job seekers ways to browse, filter, save and apply for roles, while employers can publish jobs, manage applicants, update company details, and view application-related analytics.

JOB SEEKER

Discover and apply

Dashboard, job details, saved jobs, profile, search/filter components, application status, and protected-route structure are present.

EMPLOYER

Publish and manage

Job posting, employer dashboard, job management, application viewer, and employer profile screens are included.

BACKEND

RESTful workflow

Express routes/controllers cover auth, users, jobs, applications, saved jobs, and analytics; Mongoose models represent core data.

ACCESS

Authentication path

JWT, bcryptjs, auth middleware, protected client routes, and multipart upload middleware are all visible in the repository.
